newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Level One raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Level One raised to buy.

text.p: -- Robertson, Stephens & Co said it raised its rating on shares of Level One Communications to a buy from long term attractive based on an "improving business environment."

-- Level One, a specialist in mixed-signal communications semiconductor chips, reported Q4 earnings of $0.25 a share on sales of $29.6 million versus $0.23 a share on sales of $26.5 million last year. The figures exclude special items.
-- In a statement, Robertson, Stephens analyst Elias Moosa said the quarterly report "held indications of a potentially positive inflection point in the outlook."
-- Level One shares were up 2-1/2 to 34 at mid-afternoon.
